draft_drain_timing_note: The main census matrix and original attribution pilot capture wait_ms after the untimed payload census. Do not interpret that field as worker I/O latency; phase input/switch clocks and pre-census drained working set remain valid.

verification_notes.before_census_missing_flag: The initial six-way baseline stripped the optional census environment variable. Timing/working-set data remain valid; it contains no object census or standard-close audit. A separate valid 30 MiB/3-tab pilot supplies the before attribution/close observation.
verification_notes.payload_census: Unique capacities/objects; excludes Qt/OS shaping internals, allocator overhead and unrelated/global caches. Active source-sheet image cache cost is partial, not all compiled stylesheet caches.
verification_notes.small_samples: Before one process per cell, after two; retain all variation. Not population tail estimates.

supplemental_draft_sampling.method: Separate valid 30 MiB/3-tab process, four theme cycles. Queue/resource/process samples before and after drain request and each existing 50ms poll. No concurrent builds/tests. Sampling can miss peaks; logical code units do not represent exclusive snapshot allocations. Drain wait is captured before census in this diagnostic revision.
